description: This file defines a WebSocket connection manager for interacting with OpenAI's Responses API, including event type definitions, connection handling, reconnection logic, and message processing.

classes.name: OpenAIWebSocketManager
classes.description: Manages a persistent WebSocket connection to OpenAI's Responses API, handling connection lifecycle, message processing, reconnection with exponential backoff, and event emission.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection using the provided API key, resolving when connected or rejecting on failure.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a specified event over the WebSocket connection; throws if connection is not open.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Registers a handler for incoming WebSocket events; returns an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket connection is currently open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and disables auto-reconnect.

methods.name: _openConnection
methods.description: Internal method to initiate a WebSocket connection with retries and event handling.

methods.name: _scheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules a reconnection attempt with exponential backoff.

methods.name: _safeEmitError
methods.description: Emits an error event only if there are listeners to prevent unhandled errors.

methods.name: _handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, parsing JSON and emitting events.

methods.name: warmUp
methods.description: Sends a warm-up event to pre-load the connection and model without generating output.
